description: Golden vectors for SMS segment counting (GSM 03.38), shared by server/app/domain/sms.py and web/src/lib/segments.ts. Ruling D89: the two implementations are a deliberate duplicate - the inbox composer needs per-keystroke feedback with no network round trip - so this file pins them to each other. It lives at the repo root because neither language owns it. Asserted by server/tests/test_sms.py and web/src/lib/segments.golden.test.ts; if the two drift, exactly one suite goes red and names the case. `segments` counts GSM-7 septets (extension characters count twice) or UTF-16 code units; `characters` counts user-visible characters, i.e. code points - these differ, which is the point of the emoji-crosses-* cases. Expected values are hand-computed from the spec, not generated from either implementation.

cases.name: gsm7-extension-alone
cases.why: a lone extension char is two septets, one character

cases.name: gsm7-extension-fills-160
cases.why: 158 + 2 septets = exactly 160

cases.name: gsm7-extension-crosses-160
cases.why: 159 characters + an extension char = 161 septets: SAME character count as gsm7-160, one more segment. A counter that measured length instead of septets would say 1.

cases.name: gsm7-extension-crosses-153
cases.why: same trap at the multipart boundary: 306 characters as in gsm7-306, but 307 septets

cases.name: gsm7-formfeed-fills-160
cases.why: form feed is an extension char too
